ca_cert.title: CA certificate
ca_cert.description: Optional PEM root certificate trusted in addition to the system and Amazon RDS roots. Used by verify-ca and verify-full.

change_detection.title: Use logical replication for bulk syncs
change_detection.description: Read changes for bulk syncs from PostgreSQL logical replication.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: Publication that logical replication reads changes from; required when change_detection is true.

slot_failover.title: Enable replication slot failover
slot_failover.description: Create Polytomic-managed replication slots with failover so they are synchronized to standbys; requires PostgreSQL 17 or later, and a failover slot cannot be used for logical decoding on a replica.
